model_system: Exactly solvable chiral spin liquid (CSL) model on the star lattice / decorated brick-wall lattice, represented as Majorana fermions with static Z2 gauge fields on a torus

key_params.Hamiltonian: H = J sum_{x,y,z-links} u_{ij} i c_i c_j + J' sum_{x',y',z'-links} u_{ij} i c_i c_j
key_params.physical_constraint: D_i = c_i d_i^x d_i^y d_i^z = 1 enforced by projection operator P
key_params.uniform_flux_ground_state: phi_L=-1 on all 12-plaquettes and phi_L=±1 on all triangular plaquettes
key_params.scaling: T* ~ Delta(g)/ln N for large N

headline_claim: At T=0 the global flux expectation value is <Phi_x>=1/3 in the non-Abelian phase (g<sqrt(3)) and 0 in the Abelian phase (g>sqrt(3)), implying topological ground-state degeneracy n_DEG = 4 - 3<Phi_x>.
replication_difficulty: medium — exact free-fermion/gauge-sector calculation with projection and torus boundary-condition sectors, but no heavy numerics or self-consistency.
